newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-GIO says has A$200 mln for Asia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-GIO says has A$200 mln for Asia.

text.p: Insurer GIO Australia Holdings Ltd said on Monday it could spend up to A$200 million expanding its insurance business into Asia over the coming years.

"There are four or five markets we are looking at in Asia and we could spend up to A$30 to A$40 million in each, so that is about A$150-A$200 million," group managing director Bill Jocelyn told reporters after the annual meeting.
Jocelyn said the current expenditure on Asian expansion was in the millions of dollars.
He said the insurer's five key Asian markets were India, Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.
"We are more interested in creating the right relationships at this stage rather than investing a lot of money," Jocelyn said.
Jocelyn said he now spent a lot of his time working on the group's Asian strategy.
At 1.35 p.m. (0235 GMT), GIO shares were four cents up at A$3.28.
